Hi Laura — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call (short checklist so your AP can route):

• Discussed commercial path options we can support: 1) Marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP) — fast for SSO/billing but requires marketplace onboarding and vendor listing; 2) Direct vendor invoicing (Net-30/Net-45) with PO — standard AP flow; 3) Card for initial short-term purchases (only if AP allows).
• You mentioned internal AP prefers not to put large vendors on card (we heard >$10k/month is a blocker).
• We confirmed Redwood can issue invoices against a PO and accept Net terms; small differences exist for marketplace billing (Marketplace passes through cloud provider billing cadence).

What we need from HelixOps to move:
1) Preferred billing channel (Marketplace vs vendor invoice + PO vs card) — please confirm by 2027-07-20.
2) If vendor invoice route: completed vendor form + W9 and AP contact for purchase order routing.
3) If marketplace route: let us know which marketplace (AWS/GCP) and we will kick off vendor listing (this can take ~2 weeks).

Attachments: redwood_vendor_form.pdf (vendor onboarding checklist) and sample-invoice.pdf (example invoice layout for PO routing).

Next steps & owners:
• Laura / HelixOps: confirm preferred path and attach vendor form (due 7/20).
• Marissa Cole: will open vendor onboarding once we get the form and W9.
• Karthik Iyer: will validate payment terms (Net-30 vs Net-45) and confirm timeline with Finance.

If it's helpful I can provide a one-page summary for your AP to attach to the ticket.

Thanks — Sergio

Hi Laura — looping in with specifics on timing and options from Finance/Revenue Ops. Short answers up front: yes, we can support both routes. Details below.

Option A — AWS/GCP Marketplace:
• If Redwood already has a marketplace listing, HelixOps can purchase through your existing cloud marketplace agreement; billing will flow through the marketplace provider and follow their invoice cadence.
• If we need to create a listing, the onboarding can take ~10–14 business days (marketplace paperwork + partner verification).

Option B — Direct vendor invoicing (recommended for speed):
• We can accept a PO and bill Net-30 or Net-45 (Net-45 requires a quick credit review and approval).
• Standard onboarding requirements: completed vendor form, W9, point of contact for AP, remit address, and a signed Master Services Agreement (MSA) or PO referencing the MSA.
• Timeline: once we receive the completed vendor form + W9 + PO number, Finance can activate vendor status in 3–5 business days and issue first invoice on the agreed cycle.

Notes and exceptions:
• If HelixOps needs Net-45, please indicate in the vendor form (we'll route to Credit).
• For marketplace purchases, pricing on the marketplace needs a short approval (we can list current prices under our partner account — takes extra time).

Attachments: AVP_Billing_Matrix.csv (high-level matrix mapping channel -> timeline -> required docs).

Action items:
• Laura: send completed vendor form + W9 and indicate preferred terms (Net-30 vs Net-45).
• Marissa: once vendor form is received I'll confirm expected activation date.

I'll put a short ticket in our billing queue (BILL-4521) so we can track this end-to-end.

Thanks — Karthik
